summary: Nova Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing the scheduled release of its second quarter 2026 financial results on August 6, 2026, before market open, with a conference call to follow. The press release details the date, dial-in numbers, and webcast link for the earnings call. This is a routine earnings announcement, not a special situation event. No transaction, restructuring, or strategic action is disclosed. The filing is an ordinary current report under Rule 13a-16, with no special-situation content.
